text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки fails to win the Kikuka Sho.
However,
the audience is still wildly
impressed with her for
attempting a race
she has no aptitude for.

After the race, she asks to participate in
the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a
1,200-meter G1 turf
sprint.

I'm puzzled by her sudden change of
heart, but
I'm sure she has a reason.
